visual_text: When the toothbrush is pushed away
ILLUSTRATIVE EXAMPLE Not a real person. Techniques from a US trial of 101 nursing home residents.
2. The carer comes to eye level, calmly.

Jablonski et al., Gerodontology 2018. Refusals continued; mouth health showed no clear difference over 3 weeks.
alt_text: Four panel comic, labelled illustrative. In a care home bathroom an older man pushes away a toothbrush; the carer comes to eye level calmly; he holds a brush at the mirror; the carer starts, then he carries on. Techniques from a US trial of 101 residents; refusals continued and mouth health showed no clear difference over 3 weeks.
design_instructions: Four panel comic 2x2 on sand with captions, care home bathroom with mirror and basin. Older Black man with grey hair seated; female carer in plum tunic. Panels: brush pushed away, carer kneels to eye level, he holds brush at mirror, carer's hand with his. Illustrative badge.
